issues.display_title: Issue #251: feat(video-merger): live merged preview, aspect ratio framing, and dynamic output management
issues.main_description_html:
DEMO FROM DEVELOPER

Summary

Implement the Video Merger feature improvements in Edit mode for GoThru Photo Studio:

  • Live FFmpeg-Powered Merged Preview: Background ultrafast FFmpeg preview generation for seamless, gapless playback across queued clips.
  • Aspect Ratio Adaptive Sizing: Responsive viewport sizing following target aspect ratio (16:9 Landscape or 9:16 Portrait) without letterbox/pillarbox voids.
  • Dynamic Output Management: Custom output location toggle in settings, defaulting to source folder with full-width input.
  • Full Player Controls: Unified scrubber timeline, playback speed options, mute/volume slider, and theater fullscreen mode.
  • Backend IPC Commands: Added video_merger_generate_preview and video_merger_preview_stop in Tauri Rust backend.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Video Merger is accessible from the Edit menu.
  • Adding 2+ videos generates a seamless merged preview via FFmpeg.
  • Preview player width is full width with height accurately tracking the 16:9 / 9:16 aspect ratio.
  • Scrubber timeline reflects total combined duration and allows smooth seeking.
  • Output Directory is full-width to the right margin with Custom Output Location switch.
  • Fullscreen toggle works cleanly and exits via button or Escape / F.
  • All 243 automated unit tests pass and TypeScript / Rust checks pass.
